<MethodEndpoint

Microservices-only AutoPay subscription-management proxy. Connect terminates merchant authentication using private API key, Basic auth, or Keycloak JWT, resolves the merchant tenant, forwards the request to AutoPay with Merchant-Id, and returns AutoPay's response body and status to the merchant.

Invalidates the existing customer-facing hosted-page token and returns AutoPay's regenerated token payload.
The previous link stops working the moment you call this endpoint, and Ottu does not tell the customer. Send the new `page_url` yourself, or the customer reaches a dead link. Use it to revoke a link that leaked or was lost, not to re-send a working one.

After a timeout, read the current link with Retrieve an AutoPay hosted-page link and compare its `page_url` with the one you hold before you retry. A blind retry can revoke a link you have just delivered.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location --globoff --request POST 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/regenerate-page-token/' \\\n--header 'Idempotency-Key: <uuid>' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY'"}</pre>
